title: Tell HN: New features and a moderator
author: dang
excerpt: Today we'd like to introduce five new features and one moderator. 1. You can collapse comments in threads. If you're logged in, collapses persist across page refreshes and devices for a week. 2. You can tell which way you voted and undo a vote if you want. An 'unvote' or 'undown' link appears after a post's timestamp when you vote. 3. Save and share the best stories and comments.
